newsitem.title: JAPAN: Qatar trims Marine, Land formuals for January.
newsitem.headline: Qatar trims Marine, Land formuals for January.

text.p: Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has cut its price formula for both January-lifting Qatar Land crude oil and Qatar Marine by two cents per barrel from December, traders in Tokyo said on Thursday.

According to the QGPC formula, January Qatar Land was calculated at Oman plus 66 cents per barrel, which translated into $23.16 per barrel, and January Qatar Marine at Oman plus 59 cents per barrel, or $23.09 per barrel.
December Qatar Land was set at Oman plus 68 cents per barrel, or $23.50 per barrel, and December Qatar Marine at Oman plus 61 cents per barrel, or $23.43 per barrel.
Qatar's retroactive price formula is based on the official selling price of Oman issued monthly by Oman's Ministry of Petroleum and Mines.
